title: Наше будущее (Промпт)
description: Скопируй промпт в чат с ИИ и обсуди будущее и планы. Станция засчитывается, когда ты реально поговорил.

promptCard.prompt: Ты — мой сверстник из англоговорящей страны. Мне ___ лет. Давай поговорим о том, как мы видим нашу жизнь в будущем и какие у нас планы. Отвечай на мои вопросы и задавай свои на эту тему. Используй Present Simple (расписания), Present Continuous (100% планы), going to (намерения), Future Simple (предсказания). Исправь меня, если я ошибусь, но только в конце нашего диалога и в очень дружеской форме)

extra.title: Dialogue: “Our Future Plans”
lines: Liza: Hey, Masha! Have you thought about your future? What do you think you will do after school?
Masha: Hi Liza! Yes, I have. I think I will become a doctor. I really want to help people. What about you?
Liza: I'm not sure yet, but I think I will work with children, maybe as a teacher or a paediatrician. What are you going to do next year?
Masha: I'm going to enter medical university. I'm already studying hard for the exams. Are you going to go to university too?
Liza: Yes, I'm going to study education. I'm really interested in how children learn. By the way, what are you doing this weekend?
Masha: I'm meeting my cousin on Saturday morning, and I'm having coffee with my best friend on Sunday. What about you?
Liza: I'm visiting my grandparents on Saturday, and I'm dancing in a competition on Sunday afternoon. Our performance starts at 2 p.m. every Sunday during the season.
Masha: Nice! By the way, the new school term starts on September 1st, right?
Liza: Yes, it does. Lessons begin at 8:30 a.m., so I will need to wake up early again!
Masha: Haha, same here! But I think we will manage. Our future is going to be amazing!
Liza: Definitely! We will achieve our goals, for sure!
